issue_boxes: P3 box 2: Use official RDF reference alignments and MELT scoring.
P3 box 3: Add at least one natural ontology-pair track; bench23 alone is generated from one seed ontology.
P3 box 4: Compare against LogMap and AML, or mark unavailable arms CANNOT_CHECK.
P3 box 5: Bootstrap/aggregate by ontology pair or track, not correspondence row.

preconditions_at_freeze.note: Inherited from SOURCE_FAMILY_RIGHTS.json boundary (metadata-only audit) and the licence manifest's download status. This analysis contract therefore froze before any outcome-bearing artifact existed.

gold_standard_rule.detail: Gold is the official RDF reference alignment shipped with each selected suite (e.g. bench23 per-test refalign.rdf; Conference reference-alignment archive). No third-party, self-constructed or partial-substitute reference may enter scoring.
gold_standard_rule.substitute_policy: If a reference cannot be lawfully obtained for a suite, that suite is dropped and recorded CANNOT_CHECK — never replaced by a weaker self-built gold.

scoring_rule.note: MELT is MIT-licensed (licence bound in the licence manifest). No MELT run has been performed in this repository; declaring it required here binds the future run, it does not claim one.

case_composition_rule.multi_case_requirement: The analysis unit is multi-case: bench23 (generated, single seed ontology, systematic alterations) MUST be paired with at least one natural ontology-pair track (Conference ra1 primary candidate; Biodiv secondary) so that conclusions are not readable off one construction process.
case_composition_rule.natural_pair_blocker: The natural-pair candidates are licence-blocked (CANNOT_CHECK) in the licence manifest; the analysis may not start until one is unblocked or a lawful alternative natural-pair source is verified. Scoring bench23 alone and generalizing would violate this freeze.

public_participation_evidence.finding: LogMap (with LogMapLt) is listed among OAEI 2025 Conference participants; the page reports LogMap at F1-measure 0.61 for that track. Exact tool version not bound from the page.
AML is listed among OAEI 2025 Conference participants (named alongside Lily and LogMap families in the track discussion). Exact tool version not bound from the page.

unavailable_arm_policy: Arms that cannot be executed are recorded CANNOT_CHECK and stay in the report as unavailable; weak proxies are never substituted for an unavailable comparator.

statistical_unit_rule.inference_unit: ontology pair or track — never the correspondence row
statistical_unit_rule.aggregation: Per-suite scores are computed first (per ontology pair or track), and all cross-suite statistics aggregate those suite-level scores. Correspondence rows are nested inside suites and treating them as independent units is pseudoreplication.
statistical_unit_rule.interval_method: paired bootstrap resampling over ontology pairs/tracks (the inference unit)
statistical_unit_rule.reporting_rule: Any table that reports row-level counts must label them descriptive only and must not attach an interval or significance claim computed at row level.

pass_gate.valid_output_coverage: valid standard alignment output for 100% of cases
pass_gate.primary: macro-F1 advantage >= 0.03 with paired bootstrap lower CI > 0 over the strongest runnable baseline
pass_gate.alternative: precision noninferior within 0.01 AND recall gain >= 0.05 with paired bootstrap lower CI > 0
pass_gate.logical_incoherence: zero increase in logical incoherence relative to the strongest runnable baseline
pass_gate.gate_combination: valid_output_coverage AND (primary OR alternative) AND logical_incoherence

open_world_boundary.rule: Incomplete reference alignments do not make every absent entity pair a true negative.
open_world_boundary.detail: Absence from a reference alignment is UNDETERMINED unless an authoritative per-suite contract declares the reference exhaustive over the frozen candidate universe. Global-completeness claims and open-world UNDETERMINED quantification remain bounded to the scored suites.
open_world_boundary.inherited_binding: SOURCE_FAMILY_RIGHTS.json transport_rule: no source receives valid OBSTRUCTION labels from absence without an authoritative exhaustive-reference statement; zero audited families supply one.

non_bypass_boundaries: This freeze is an analysis contract, not a result: no alignment scoring has been performed.
Changing arms, gates, statistical units or the gold rule after the first OAEI scoring artifact appears is a protocol violation and requires a new versioned freeze with a new identity.
Execution may start only after the licence manifest's preconditions hold: bench23 SHA-256 computed at download, and a natural-pair track licence-unblocked (or a lawful alternative verified).
